logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Two-panel assurance figure for the WO-03 round-3 handover. Left panel: vertical bar chart of measured energy per fixed compute acceptance batch, drawn exactly to scale at 6 px per Wh — P3 10 Wh, P2 22 Wh, P1 28 Wh, P4 49 Wh — with gridlines every 10 Wh, value labels above each bar, and a caption line stating the successive gaps 12/6/21 Wh and the 39 Wh spread, demonstrating the correct proportionality that both round-3 source figures lacked. Right panel: an audit-status checklist of four boxes — A prose clean (green), A chart fail (red: missing P2 bar, stray 0 Wh label, off-scale heights ~43/33/3 Wh vs labeled 49/28/10 Wh), B prose and right chart clean (green), B left figure fail plus missed cross-check (red: order P3,P1,P2,P4 at ~12/22/32/42 Wh, misplaced gap labels, missed A's missing P2 bar) — and a final blue reconciliation box stating the decision: P3, unique 10 Wh minimum, ballots A P4, B P3, C P3, receivers independent and correct. A footer line lists the open items carried forward: chart integrity, P3's one-slot defect margin, batch variance, and unverified cost/delivery/reliability factors. No validation tag or hidden coding appears anywhere in the figure; all text serves the client analysis.
